verdict.rationale: Mercury documents scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions, including read-only, read-write, and custom token types. It also says access can be revoked from the dashboard. Together these give an agent least-privilege credentials, but the depth of the custom scoping is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which permissions or endpoints custom tokens can be limited to, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
